title: If you can’t get a job, please watch this
description:
If you can't get a job right now, the problem isn't your skills or your experience. It's that hiring managers can't recognise you in a sea of identical CVs, because one-click applications have created extreme competition. In this video I break down why strong candidates get ignored and the personal brand system one of my students used to secure a Data Analyst offer at Citadel.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why companies keep ghosting you
0:36 The volume problem (300+ apps per role)
1:28 It's visibility, not skill
1:48 What personal brand actually means
3:09 John's Citadel data analyst story
4:43 The 4-line personal story framework
6:14 Distribute your brand everywhere
7:15 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
